title: Renovating a 15-20 Year Old Sushant Lok Home: A Room-by-Room Interior Upgrade Guide
author: Shivam Kumar

excerpt: Own an older independent floor or builder floor in Sushant Lok? Here's a practical, room-by-room interior renovation guide for homes 15-20 years old.
keyTakeaways: Renovate Room by Room, Not All at Once — Kitchen, bathrooms, and electrical systems in Sushant Lok homes age at different rates.
Independent Floor Owners Carry Building-Envelope Responsibility — Roof waterproofing and external walls are yours to maintain, unlike managed societies.
Budget ₹25-45 Lakh for a Full Renovation — 16-20 weeks for a 3-4 bedroom independent floor or builder floor.
Full Rewiring Beats Patching Past 15 Years — Original wiring rarely supports today's electrical loads.
Layout Flexibility Is a Real Advantage — Fewer load-bearing constraints than apartment towers open up genuine reconfiguration options.
contentHtml:
A Sushant Lok independent floor or builder floor that is 15-20 years old typically needs a room-by-room renovation approach rather than a single blanket "redo everything" plan — because in Sushant Lok's low-rise, plotted-development housing stock, the kitchen, bathrooms, and electrical systems usually age at different rates and need different levels of intervention.

Sushant Lok (Phases 1, 2, and 3, off MG Road) is one of Gurgaon's most established residential colonies, dominated by independent floors and builder floors on generous plots rather than high-rise towers. Here's how to plan the renovation room by room.

Why Sushant Lok Homes Age Differently From Gurgaon's High-Rise Societies

  • You own your building envelope. Roof waterproofing, external wall seepage, and terrace maintenance are your responsibility, not a society's — and these show the most wear after 15-20 years.
  • Electrical and plumbing risers are floor-specific, not shared infrastructure. No facilities team maintains common risers — upgrades are entirely on you.
  • Layouts are often more flexible. Fewer load-bearing constraints than apartment towers open up genuine room-reconfiguration options.

Room-by-Room Renovation Priorities for a 15-20 Year Old Sushant Lok Home

Kitchen

Check water inlet/outlet points against your new modular layout, verify electrical points can handle a chimney/hob/additional appliances, and assess whether existing loft/storage height suits modern modular carcasses.

Bathrooms

Waterproofing has the shortest realistic lifespan of any element (12-15 years). A full waterproofing redo, not just new tiles over old, is usually the right call, especially above ground floor. For tier-wise and line-item prices, see our guide to bathroom renovation cost in Gurgaon.

Electrical System

Original wiring was sized for far fewer points per room than today's needs. A full rewire, not a patch, is more cost-effective past the 15-year mark.

Flooring

Older marble or ceramic tile has often dulled, cracked, or gone out of level. Full re-flooring is usually justified, and a good moment to fix balcony/utility drainage slope issues.

Terrace & Roof (Independent Floor Owners)

Roof waterproofing deserves priority before any interior work — a leak here damages every floor below.

Layout & Space Planning

Fewer structural constraints make it a natural moment to reconsider layout — e.g., opening a galley kitchen to the dining area.

A Realistic Renovation Timeline for an Older Sushant Lok Floor

  • Weeks 1-2: Structural/systems assessment, design freeze.
  • Weeks 3-5: Demolition of outdated kitchen/bathroom fixtures, full electrical rewiring.
  • Weeks 6-10: Waterproofing, plumbing rework, flooring, layout changes.
  • Weeks 11-14: Modular kitchen and wardrobe installation, false ceiling, painting.
  • Weeks 15-16: Finishing, snagging, handover.

A full renovation for a 3-4 bedroom independent floor typically runs 16-20 weeks and ₹25-45 lakh — higher than a comparable flat in a newer society, due to building-envelope responsibilities unique to independent floor ownership. For context on how this compares with a similarly aged corridor, see our Sohna Road cost and timeline guide.

Why a Turnkey Partner Matters More for Independent Floor Renovations

Because a Sushant Lok renovation often spans building-envelope work as well as interior systems and design, coordinating separate specialists is where cost overruns typically happen. The Omega Group's turnkey model brings concept, 3D visualisation, material selection, site supervision, and delivery under one accountable team — with 10+ years of experience and 90+ completed Gurgaon projects.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to renovate a 15-20 year old home in Sushant Lok?
faqs.answer: ₹25-45 lakh for a full renovation of a 3-4 bedroom independent floor or builder floor, typically 16-20 weeks from assessment to handover.

faqs.question: Should I rewire my entire Sushant Lok home during renovation?
faqs.answer: Yes, in most cases — homes this age were wired for far lower loads than current usage requires.

faqs.question: Why is waterproofing a priority in older Sushant Lok floor renovations?
faqs.answer: Bathroom/terrace waterproofing typically lasts 12-15 years. Redoing it fully prevents damage that would undo new interior work.

faqs.question: Can I change the layout of an independent floor in Sushant Lok?
faqs.answer: Often yes — fewer load-bearing wall constraints than apartment towers make reconfiguration more feasible, subject to a structural assessment.

faqs.question: What's different about renovating an independent floor versus a Gurgaon apartment?
faqs.answer: Independent floor owners are responsible for their own roof, external walls, and floor-specific risers — responsibilities apartment owners in managed societies don't have.
